scientific_integrity: Proof of the arbitrary-dimensional integral homotopy classification and of the integral persistence-module comparison split at radius three. Field barcodes are compared in full. Finite checks at radius two are corroboration only.
scientific_limitations: A single deleted edge in an unweighted binary cube of dimension at least three. No classification or torsion-freeness assertion for the common integral higher-scale homology. Bibliographic priority is provisional.
title: A one-edge fault removes exactly \(n-2\) hypercube Rips three-spheres
